status: retrospective_development; historical labels were seen in previous experiments; not blind validation
purpose: Test whether known assessment-stock history and within-vintage resource changes improve a cross-report planning-revision forecast, without asserting a physical accreditation crosswalk
case_set: Unchanged 150 matched region-origin-target cases, leads 1-5, 42 distinct region-target outcomes
training_rule: forecast origin < test origin AND outcome year <= test origin; same-year SRA is published before LTRA
drift_rule: Median of at most three most recent consecutive annual changes in SRA components known at the origin; at least two changes required, else zero. Not fitted or selected against future outcomes
demand_response_rule: Reuse prior anchored-component bounded LAD rules; fit each component only on matured past cases. No joint balance fitting, fitted intercept, region-specific fitted weights or additional candidate search
resource_trend: SRA anticipated resources at origin plus lead times past median annual SRA resource change, clipped to nonnegative; anticipated anchor includes Tier1 and is NOT operating inventory
trend_level_resources: Resource trend plus one pooled [0,1] coefficient times (official target resource level minus resource trend)
change_only_bridge: Resource trend plus one pooled [0,1] coefficient times (official target minus official first-forward-year resources minus (lead-1) times known historical resource drift). Removes cross-report level offsets, not a proven capacity-currency transformation
cold_start: Same-reference persistence when training lacks support; the unfitted historical-drift comparator remains separately reported
primary_metric: Complete native accounting balance MAE in GW
reference_rule: Source-vintage target RML for new models; retain origin-RML persistence separately. No future RML as forecast input
acceptance: Lower both MAEs than BOTH persistence baselines in all-origin and fitted-origin panels, improvement under true heldout-region refitting and evaluation region/vintage deletion, positive approximate region and outcome-year block-bootstrap improvement intervals. Separately beat resource-drift-calibrated-load to substantiate added source-forward information
heldout_rule: Heldout-region future outcomes excluded from parameter training; its origin-available history is still a permitted predictor, as at deployment
outcome: Later NERC SRA summer planning assessments, not realized outages or measured future accredited capacity
physical_boundaries: No generic ELCC multiplier or arbitrary resource/RML rescaling; existing rule changes remain in native scores; bridge coefficients are planning-statistic calibration, not completion probabilities
data_audit: Trace source capacity definitions and existing/Tier1/transfer identity; audit EIA archive timing. December year-end snapshots are not silently treated as known at that December LTRA publication. EIA capacities are not assigned native capacity credit without a supported crosswalk
transport: Only 1-5 years and six areas tested; no automatic 2031-2035 or WECC-California extrapolation
preservation: New independent local directory only; no existing results, paper, SI, figures or Overleaf files replaced
